Starflares, Byeolbitdans, let’s make some noise and take action! 📢 

We’re in the semi-finals of the Best Vocal Star competition, and it’s crunch time — voting closes tomorrow, July 28 at 11 AM KST (10 AM PHT)! Let’s finish this round STRONG and make sure JL gets the semi-finals WIN he truly deserves.

So let’s spread the word, vote like there’s no tomorrow, and secure those KOOKYs in record numbers!

✅ Check in daily on KOOKY for bonus KOOKYs
💬 Engage in the community (like posts, leave comments)
❤️ Tap that poll with love

📊 Climb that pre-rank board together

📢 Share it across all socials
🤝 Rally fellow fans — DM, tag, remind
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Call in support from family and friends Let’s leave no KOOKY unclaimed and no vote uncast!

WHY WE’RE PUSHING HARD: Just look at these prizes that await JL if we make it through:

🏁 Grand Finalists:
- Huge Subway Ad in Hongdae (7 days)

🥇 Grand Finals Winner:
 - LED Ad at Singapore Football Stadium (Oct 9)
- Official KOOKY Trophy
- Outdoor Ad in Bangkok (1 day)

JL deserves the spotlight — and WE have the POWER to make it happen, so let's make it happen!
